title: A/R Summary: the Totals row adds up exactly the rows each filter leaves
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role, with {Location-A} as your current location.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • The organization has open documents in these reports at two locations, {Location-A} and {Location-B}, and you are enrolled at both; {Location-A}'s name comes first in A to Z order.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919 and {Location-B} is Staging Lethbridge - 4310.
  • {Customer-A} has an invoice of $1,000.00 at {Location-A} 15 days past due, an invoice of $400.00 at {Location-B} 45 days past due and an unused credit memo of $150.00 at {Location-A}; {Customer-B} has an invoice of $700.00 at {Location-A} 45 days past due and an invoice of $250.00 at {Location-B} 100 days past due; {Customer-C} has an invoice of $900.00 at {Location-A} 5 days past due. Nothing else is open for the three on today's date.
    For example: {Customer-A} is ZZAUTOTEST DATA-07 Alpha, {Customer-B} is ZZAUTOTEST DATA-07 Bravo and {Customer-C} is ZZAUTOTEST DATA-07 Charlie.
  • Starting screen: Reports > Finance > A/R Summary is open in a desktop browser window 1440 px wide, as opened from the Reports menu.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. In the Customer filter, tick {Customer-A} and {Customer-B}.
  2. Read both rows and the Totals row.
  3. In the Location filter, untick {Location-B}.
  4. Read both rows and the Totals row.
  5. In the Location menu, click "Select all".
  6. In the Past due filter, tick "91+ days".
  7. Read the rows and the Totals row.
  8. Download the PDF and the CSV from the ⋯ menu and read their Totals rows.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: two rows remain; {Customer-C} is gone.
  • Step 2: {Customer-A} appears once, with Location "Multiple" and a Total of $1,250.00 (1,000.00 + 400.00 − 150.00); {Customer-B}'s Total is $950.00 (700.00 + 250.00); the Totals row's Total is $2,200.00 (1,250.00 + 950.00).
  • Step 3: the report narrows to {Location-A}.
  • Step 4: {Customer-A}'s Total is $850.00 (1,000.00 − 150.00, its {Location-A} documents only); {Customer-B}'s is $700.00; the Totals row's Total is $1,550.00.
  • Step 5: every location is ticked again.
  • Step 6: the chip reads "Past due: 91+ days".
  • Step 7: only {Customer-B} is listed ({Customer-A} has nothing more than 90 days past due), at its full balance: 31-60 Days $700.00, 91 And Over $250.00, Total $950.00; the Totals row's Total is $950.00.
  • Step 8: both Totals rows read $950.00 for the Total, the same as the screen.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter", Confluence 947650561, version 5 (21 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 22 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11315, story SV-11535 (Story 5, Filters: customer or vendor, past due and location), story SV-11536 (Story 6, Location column)

  • S5-R18: “The Totals row always adds up exactly the rows the filters leave (customer or vendor, Past due, Location), on screen on every page, in the PDF and in the CSV. On A/R Collection and A/P Unpaid Invoices this fixes today's Totals row, which ignores the customer or vendor filter.”
  • S5-R8: “On the Summaries, a customer's or vendor's row adds up only their open documents at the chosen locations; a customer or vendor with nothing open there is not listed.”
  • S5-R17: “With ranges ticked, A/R Summary and A/P Summary list only the customers or vendors with some open invoice or bill amount in a ticked range; their rows show their full balances in every bucket.”
  • S6-R4: “On A/R Summary and A/P Summary a row shows the location's name when all of that customer's or vendor's open documents at the chosen locations are at one location, otherwise "Multiple".”
  • Key Decisions, row location: “A row belongs to the location of its own open document (the invoice, credit memo or deposit; the bill or vendor credit), the same location the Location column shows. Rationale: the aging reports list open documents, not payments, so a partly paid invoice keeps its own location and the filter never contradicts the column. Rejected: splitting a balance by where each payment was taken.”
